title: Fix JSON extraction fragile against real LLM output (ExtractJsonObjectPayload)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG4-09 / F58 (memorysmith-jsonextraction-audit-26-07-19-22-27-48)

## Problem
`ExtractJsonObjectPayload` uses naive "first `{` to last `}`" extraction with `StartsWith("```")` code-fence detection that only triggers if fence is the literal first 3 characters. Both consumers (`ParseTaskOutput`, `ParseProposalReview`) catch `JsonException` and fall back silently, discarding real LLM review output on common response shapes.

## Severity
Medium-High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` lines 1856-1877

## Recommendation
Replace with regex for fenced-block-anywhere + proper brace-depth counter with string-literal awareness.

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Audit synthesis corroboration: the redacted audit confirms brittle brace-slicing and code-fence handling can discard realistic model output. This is an exact overlap with the existing JSON extraction task; no duplicate task will be created.
